new.directions: Use the designated riverside access off Green River Lakes Road. This marker identifies an approximate access area, not a surveyed ramp or a bank to aim for. Check road, water and site conditions before launching.
new.note: WGFD lists this location as a launch and take-out. The agency Green River guide places the reach on National Forest land; aerial review corroborates the riverside area and nearby road. Exact landing geometry and usable bank are not confirmed, so only an approximate area marker is offered.

new.directions: Use the signed southern Jelm parking area off WY-10. The agency maps a primitive boat ramp here; the map marker locates its area. Stay within posted easements; access roads and parking are not plowed in winter.
new.note: WGFD lists a launch and take-out. Its Jelm GeoPDF places the boat-ramp symbol at the same southern access area as river-access feature 135. The facility page confirms a primitive launch. Retained as an area marker rather than an exact ramp coordinate.
